tasks.goal: Chip analysis for the A100 target: read chip.md in full plus every path its `## Target pack` section declares (they must resolve inside the project), split the target description into provenance-labelled ChipFacts covering execution model (unit of parallel work, execution resources, scheduling unit, distribution mechanism, synchronization, observable concurrency incl. worker-count semantics), memory (address spaces, visibility rule, synchronization primitives, access constraints, host/accelerator allocation and transfer model), isa (instruction repertoire including explicitly absent operations: RVV vector support, IME matrix support, tails, BF16/FP16 format-control gap), registers/resource budget, toolchain and build path, runtime/launch model, numeric behaviour (rounding, special values, integer semantics), and constraints; record every statement as a Fact with a non-empty source anchor (document anchor inside the declared material, RUNTIME_PROBE/EMPIRICAL for measured facts naming the command), record Assumptions with validation methods for anything the material does not state, keep conditional design guidance out of Facts, and write CHIP_ANALYSIS.md. Correctness_only scope: no performance anchors (achievable rates, launch floor, noise) are required; retain sourced instruction/resource constraints and functional probes. Identify the knowledge profile line (or record its absence as the skill directs).
acceptance: CHIP_ANALYSIS.md exists and covers every category the input compilation path needs: execution_model, memory, isa, registers, toolchain/abi, runtime/launch, numeric behaviour, constraints — each property from the TGT-* question lists either answered from the material, measured with a recorded command, or recorded as an Assumption with a validation method; nothing silently defaulted.

Every recorded Fact has a non-empty source; facts extracted from the declared target pack cite the document anchor inside that material; measured facts name the command and conditions; conditional experience is not recorded as a Fact.
Every path the `## Target pack` section of chip.md declares was read and resolves inside the project root.

Negative facts are recorded explicitly (absent instructions, absent linker capabilities, the pinned emulator's BF16 IME format-control gap kept unverified, RVV tail behaviour, absent hardware features).
The knowledge profile declaration is present or its absence is recorded in CHIP_ANALYSIS.md as the skill directs.
No active UNKNOWN-confidence fact blocks the plan; contradictions affecting codegen are reported rather than averaged.
No performance anchor, timing or speedup is recorded or required (correctness_only scope).
tests: PYTHONPATH from .env loaded, python3 -m compiler_agent --root . --json gates shows the G1 'chip categories address their properties' advisory check satisfied via CHIP_ANALYSIS.md with sourced facts
python3 -m compiler_agent --root . --json status shows chip facts with confidence FACT/RUNTIME_PROBE/EMPIRICAL and non-empty sources, and no active blocking UNKNOWN
